fair_value.method: Blend of five non-multiple methods: (a) roadmap milestone rNPV $12.67 (w 0.30); (b) McKinsey-TAM share states $14.12 (0.20); (c) reverse DCF turned into a value $14.63 (0.10); (e)+(d) cash/SOTP floor $7.39 plus real option, total $11.60 (0.15); (f) Quantinuum-anchored transaction mark $21.02 (0.25). All are on 445M horizon diluted shares, after the 79M out-of-the-money 2032 warrants. EV/sales is shown as an unweighted sanity check.

methods.name: other
methods.inputs: (a) Milestone rNPV on IonQ's own roadmap. Tree: P(256-qubit system at ~99.99% 2Q fidelity by end-2027)=0.70; P(10,000-qubit/800-logical chip by end-2029 | stage 1)=0.40; P(leading share of fault-tolerant market | stage 2)=0.55. States: leader 0.154, on-time contender 0.126, late contender 0.147 (stage 1 ok, stage 2 late, 35% reach FT by 2033), fail 0.573. 2035 values: leader rev $8.55B x 25% EBIT x 25x = $53.4B; contender $3.42B x 18% x 20x = $12.3B; late $2.0B x 12% x 20x = $4.8B; discounted 8.2y at 13% (x0.367) -> $19.6B / $4.5B / $1.8B at horizon. Gross computing value $3.85B - PV post-horizon burn $1.18B - expected warrant claim $0.33B + floor $3.29B = $5.80B / 445M horizon shares = $12.67.

inputs_detail.derivation: Q1-2026 release: full 256-qubit system moving to system-level testing and first unit sold to Cambridge; DARPA advanced IonQ to QBI Stage C on 2026-10-07 after a year of plan scrutiny; Eichinger doubts the jump from an 8-qubit cell, so not >0.8.

IonQ targets 800 logical qubits in 2027 vs IBM 200 logical by 2029 (Starling) and D-Wave 100 logical by 2032: IonQ's plan is 4-8x more aggressive than peers on the same dates, and Eichinger flags a ~40x one-year scale-up; two years of slack still leaves it below even odds.
6 publicly named Stage C teams across 5 modalities (DARPA); if IonQ hits stage 2 by 2029 it would be ahead of IBM's dated plan, so better than even odds of a top-2 position.
McKinsey Quantum Technology Monitor 2026 as summarised by PostQuantum.

EBITDA margin = EV/sales divided by EV/EBITDA; EBIT margin 25% (leader) after D&A, 18% contender, 12% late.
10y UST 4.99% (Sep-2026) + beta ~1.6 x 5% equity premium = 13%; failure risk is in the tree probabilities, not the rate.
TTM FCF -$483.9M (F82), TTM operating loss -$1,006M (F13); assumes ~4 more years of ~$0.5B burn in success states, cut to ~2 years on failure.

Floor = net cash at horizon $1.40B + SkyWater $1.30B + other acquired operating units $0.59B = $3.29B; components sourced in the cash/SOTP method.
381.0M (F79) + 24.14M SkyWater + 17.60M RSU + 4.06M PSU + 2.77M options + 1.61M in-the-money warrants = 431.2M; + ~12M new SBC grants (~$400M at ~$32) + ~2M small all-stock deals = 445M.

Strip out $1.9B of operating units and add $1.2B PV of further burn: the computing platform must be worth a 2035 EV of ~$33.6B at 13%, i.e. ~$1.53B EBIT, or ~$6.1B revenue at a 25% margin. That is ~11% of McKinsey's $57B 2035 midpoint, achieved with certainty, versus 2026 standalone revenue of $280-290M. My probability-weighted 2035 EBIT is $0.55B (36% of that). reasoning: Industry lane. (1) IonQ is now the revenue leader among quantum pure-plays: Q2-26 $80.1M vs Quantinuum $8M, Rigetti $5.1M, D-Wave $3.1M. But ~40% of FY26 revenue will be SkyWater foundry ($442M FY25, 12% adj. EBITDA margin), and much of the rest is systems, space and networking. (2) Independent validation is real but partial. DARPA moved IonQ to QBI Stage C on 2026-10-07 (six named finalists across modalities); Quantinuum has not yet advanced. An independent expert (Eichinger) still doubts the 256 to 10,000-qubit jump. IonQ's dated targets (800 logical qubits in 2027) are far ahead of IBM (200 logical by 2029) and D-Wave (100 logical by 2032), which raises the odds of slippage. (3) Market marks: Quantinuum, the closest trapped-ion peer, trades at ~$6.6B EV, down 61% from its high; Infleqtion went public at $1.8B. On those marks IonQ's implied ~$9.7B computing value is rich. (4) Valuation: four non-multiple methods (rNPV $12.7, TAM $14.1, option $11.6, reverse-DCF value $14.6) cluster at $12-15. The transaction mark gives $21. The blend is $15.08 at the horizon, after a ~$1.2B warrant overhang and SBC dilution. (5) Ladder: a three-scenario lognormal mixture (bear $13/0.35, base $24/0.45, bull $55/0.20, within-scenario vol 0.40-0.45) gives a median ~$22 and a mean ~$28.7. That is below spot because of both the valuation gap and vol drag (~85-90% vol means the median sits well under the mean), but well above fair value because sector sentiment can persist.
